items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Her and Leonard Kunstadt(?), they had a joint record company together

ctx.x: Yeah. Victoria Spivey and Sweet Pea Spivey, two sisters. They came out of Arkansas, or maybe St. Louis. And they made quite a name for themselves -- moreso Victoria. And she came around New York, came around New York in her later years. Her and Leonard Kunstadt(?), they had a joint record company together, tried to promote their own records. But time had marched on.
While we're talking about, let's digress a little bit. We were talking about this club where you worked, the Nest, and how you had what you call ups.
